content: Baek Cheon drove his heels into the granite, aligning his skeletal frame to absorb three hundred foot-pounds of torque. His sword cut through the 'Seven Wave Cascade.' Three distinct petal vortices formed at the perimeter, maintaining coherence for one point two seconds.
critique: Sanderson/Gosu: Skeletal torque alignment, vortex coherence time.

content: He did not fight the sword; he became its breath. His blade sang with the heavy, unyielding roar of a great tree bending before a winter blizzard. As his steel snapped through the air, three crimson blossoms unfolded from the blade tip, dancing like sparks from a roaring hearth.
critique: Rothfuss/Inoue: Grand romantic resonance, roaring hearth imagery.

content: Roaring like an angry tiger, Baek Cheon stepped forward and slashed. *BOOM!* The air detonated. A cluster of pink petals blasted forward, striking the solid oak training dummy twenty paces away. The iron-bound post didn't just split—it shattered into thousands of fragrant, flying chips!
critique: Biga/Studio LICO: Explosive power, shattered dummy post, roaring tiger energy.
